map.由期望损失与暴露单位求纯费率: Pure rate from expected loss and exposure units
map.输入期望损失与风险暴露单位数，求纯费率。: Enter expected loss and number of risk exposure units to find the pure rate.
map.纯费率 = 期望损失 / 风险暴露: Pure rate = expected loss / risk exposure
map.📖 查看「由期望损失与暴露单位求纯费率 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pure Rate from Expected Loss and Exposure Units User Guide"
map.纯费率 = 期望损失/暴露单位: Pure rate = expected loss / exposure unit
map.纯费率为风险对价基础。: The pure rate is the basis of risk consideration.
map.📚 深度解析：纯费率（期望损失/暴露单位）: 📚 Deep Dive: Pure Rate (Expected Loss / Exposure Unit)
map.由期望损失除以暴露单位得每单位纯费率。: Divide expected loss by exposure units to get the per-unit pure rate.
map.做费率厘定的最底层依据。: It is the bottom-layer basis for rate making.
map.纯费率 = 1000/100 = 10/单位。即每暴露单位纯保费 10 元。: Pure rate = 1000/100 = 10/unit. That is, pure premium is 10 ¥ per exposure unit.
map.纯费率和毛费率差？: Difference between pure and gross rate?
map.纯费率只覆盖期望损失；毛费率 = 纯费率×(1+附加费率)，再加费用利润安全边际: Pure rate covers only expected loss; gross rate = pure rate × (1+loading rate), plus expense, profit and safety margin.
map.纯费率能直接对外报价吗？: Can the pure rate be quoted externally?
map.不能。纯费率是每单位暴露的风险成本，对外报价要在其上加附加费率（费用加利润加税）: No. The pure rate is the per-unit risk cost; external quotes add a loading rate (expense + profit + tax) on top to get the gross rate; the pure rate is only the pricing starting point.
